definitions.explanation: Not yet decided or established; remaining unknown or variable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{不確定|ふかくてい}だ。
{不確定|ふかくてい}な⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}て→立てる：01196_tateru⟧にくい。
examples.english: There are too many uncertain factors to make a plan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{収入|しゅうにゅう}→収入：03213_shuunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{不確定|ふかくてい}な⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{控|ひか}えている→控える：10054_hikaeru⟧。
examples.english: Because my future income is uncertain, I'm holding off on major purchases.

notes:
A Sino-Japanese compound ({不|ふ} negative + ⟦{確定|かくてい}→確定：13707_kakutei⟧ definite/fixed) used in formal and semi-formal contexts. It describes situations, facts, or quantities that have not been settled or cannot be predicted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不確定|ふかくてい}⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧ — uncertain factor/element
- {不確定|ふかくてい}⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ — uncertainty (as a quality)
- {不確定|ふかくてい}⟦{原理|げんり}→原理：00066_genri⟧ — uncertainty principle (physics)
- {不確定|ふかくてい}な⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧ — unconfirmed information

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不確|ふたし}か→不確か：11362_futashika⟧ — uncertain, vague; more subjective and colloquial, often about personal impressions or memory
- ⟦{未定|みてい}→未定：14985_mitei⟧ — undecided; specifically means a decision has not yet been made, while {不確定|ふかくてい} is broader and can mean inherently unknowable
- ⟦{曖昧|あいまい}→曖昧：08051_aimai⟧ — ambiguous, vague; focuses on lack of clarity rather than lack of determination
